title.en: Common-source amplifier with divider bias, source bypass and RC coupling
title.zh: 共源放大器：分压偏置、源极退化加旁路、RC 耦合

description.en: A single NMOS common-source stage with divider bias, a bypassed source resistor and capacitive coupling at the input and output. Schematic generated by the RNL solver.
description.zh: 单管 NMOS 共源放大级：分压偏置，源极电阻加旁路电容，输入和输出电容耦合。原理图由 RNL 求解器生成。
